integrity: Theorem proved by resource flux, regenerative killing representation, and a Laplace asymptotic. Standalone exact-rational checker compares two separately formulated finite-state systems. Historical priority remains provisional where key older catastrophe-process full text was unavailable.
scientific_limitations: One basal resource; finite exchangeable specialist guild; constant independent consumer immigration and disappearance; additive linear resource loss \(e+kj\); all five rates strictly positive; stationarity of finite CTMC. Infinite-guild limit is a mathematical scaling, not an empirical forecast.
title: A universal biodiversity-inhibition threshold for a resource-dependent consumer guild
